jobs.description:
Location: Remote

Job Type: Contractor

**Job Description**
-------------------

Independent Contractor (1099)

Aegis Software is engaging experienced independent contractors to deliver FactoryLogix MES implementations for manufacturing customers, as demand for our software implementations grows. You'll act as the technical consultant on projects you accept: configuring, installing, deploying and integrating Aegis software so it meets the customer's business requirements and runs smoothly in their infrastructure or on a pre-configured cloud instance. Engagements cover the whole implementation lifecycle, from needs assessment and planning through go-live and handoff to support.

This engagement is for an independent, self-directed professional. You decide how and when the work gets done, solve complex deployment problems as they arise, and are accountable for results against each project's scope documents and success criteria.

  

#### **Engagement Terms**

* **Structure:** Individual independent contractor (1099). A signed W-9 is required before work starts.
* **Length:** Ongoing, reviewed annually by both parties.
* **Hours:** No fixed or minimum hours. Work is offered based on project demand, and you choose which projects to accept.
* **Location:** Remote, anywhere in the United States. Customer site visits as projects require.
* **Travel:** Up to 50% on accepted projects. Reasonable travel expenses are reimbursable as set out in the contractor agreement.
* **Rate:** Paid per billable hour. Rate based on experience.
* **Invoicing:** Monthly invoice for hours delivered, supported by the billable hours recorded in Aegis's project system. Payment terms per the contractor agreement.
* **Agreement:** All terms are governed by a written Independent Contractor Agreement (ICA).

**Scope of Work**
-----------------

On each accepted project, deliverables are defined in the project's scope documents. Typical deliverables include:

* **Customer requirements:** Work with customer executives and end users to understand their business needs and translate requirements into system configurations.
* **Installation and configuration:** Install, configure and tailor the software to the customer's workflows, in line with the project's business goals.
* **Integration and readiness:** Integrate the software with the customer's existing systems. Before deployment, provide clear guidance so validation and testing are completed ahead of rollout.
* **Issue resolution:** Diagnose and resolve technical issues during and after implementation. When an issue can't be resolved right away, document the work done, collect logs and enter clear ticket notes so it can be driven to resolution.
* **End-user training:** Deliver training built around real-world scenarios so users retain what they learn and adopt the system. Aegis training materials are available; you may adapt them to the customer's workflows.
* **Documentation:** Produce implementation checklists, user guides, quick-start guides, meeting agendas and similar project materials. Submit activity reports of completed work for customer sign-off.
* **Project coordination:** Coordinate with the Aegis Project Manager assigned to each project on milestones, deliverables and handoff to support. Technical escalations go to Aegis lead implementation engineers.
* **Billable time records:** Record billable hours and reimbursable expenses in Aegis's project system so Aegis can invoice its customers.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* 5+ years in software implementation, MES/ERP deployment or related technical consulting, including at least two full-lifecycle MES implementations
* Working knowledge of Microsoft SQL Server (queries, scripts)
* Experience deploying to or administering cloud environments (Azure or AWS)
* Experience integrating MES with ERP systems and shop-floor equipment
* Strong troubleshooting skills: able to analyze system issues and determine how to resolve them
* Excellent written and spoken communication with customers and internal teams
* Ability to act as a trusted advisor who translates business needs into technical solutions
* Proven ability to deliver independently with minimal oversight
* Able to travel up to 50% on accepted projects
  

#### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Hands-on FactoryLogix experience
* Background in electronics (SMT/PCBA) or discrete manufacturing
* Familiarity with machine connectivity standards
* Prior independent contracting or consulting experience

You’ll design and deliver training, presentations, and workshops that help community partners, contractors, and Skill Demand’s own teams understand home energy assessments, energy efficiency measures, and program requirements, and apply them correctly.

**Why This Role Exists**

Skill Demand delivers energy efficiency programs through many channels: community organizations, contractors, retail outreach, and our Contact Center. All of them rely on accurate, consistent technical information.

As our programs grow, we need a dedicated technical educator to makes sure our staff and partners:

* Understands program requirements the same way
* Has practical, up-to-date resources they can actually use
* Catches technical and documentation issues before they become problems

**Key Responsibilities**

*Approximate time allocations are shown to give a sense of the role’s focus.*

***Technical Training, Education & Presentations (50%)***

* Design and deliver technical training, presentations, and workshops, in person and virtually, for community partners, contractors, and Skill Demand teams including Retail Outreach, Contact Center, and Community Outreach
* Develop training materials such as slide decks, job aids, quick-reference guides, checklists, and short how-to videos
* Translate complex topics (building science, assessment protocols, measure eligibility, documentation requirements) into clear, practical guidance suited to each audience
* Lead onboarding and refresher trainings for new partners and staff, and update content when program requirements or incentives change
* Maintain a training calendar and a central, current library of training materials
* Gather participant feedback and use it, along with recurring quality assurance and documentation errors, to improve training
* Coordinate with team leads so training supports each team’s goals

***Project & Workload Management***

* Manage multiple training projects and technical assignments at once, from planning through delivery
* Set timelines and milestones, track deliverables, and provide regular, brief status updates, including early notice when something is at risk
* Prioritize competing requests with your supervisor through an agreed intake process
* Keep organized records of training sessions, attendance, material versions, and follow-up items
* Use project management tools (such as Asana) to track work and keep progress visible to the team

***Technical Subject-Matter Support (20%)***

* Serve as Skill Demand’s technical resource on home energy assessments, measure eligibility, and program documentation and quality requirements
* Answer technical questions from internal teams and partners, and turn recurring questions into FAQs, job aids, or training updates
* Act as technical liaison between partners, processing teams, and program administrators
* Help reduce documentation and quality assurance errors by spotting patterns and addressing them through training

***Program Improvement & Special Projects (15%)***

* Recommend improvements to program workflows, documentation, and training resources based on patterns seen across teams
* Support the rollout of new tools and processes through training, user guides, and troubleshooting
* Provide technical support for Retail Outreach and other special projects as assigned, with agreed scope and deadlines
* Work with internal teams and program administrators to resolve technical issues

***Community Partner Technical Support (15%)***

* Provide scheduled technical training and assistance to assigned community partners
* Join partner meetings when technical expertise or training is needed, and document action items you own
* Build trusted working relationships with partner staff through clear, consistent follow-through
* Share recurring partner technical challenges with Community Outreach staff and recommend training-based solutions
* Flag technical issues that may affect partner milestones to Community Outreach leadership

**Required Qualifications**

* 3+ years of experience in residential energy efficiency, home performance, weatherization, or a related field
* 2+ years of experience developing and delivering technical training, presentations, or workshops for adult audiences
* Strong working knowledge of home energy assessments, energy efficiency measures, and program documentation and compliance
* Demonstrated ability to independently manage multiple projects with competing deadlines
* Proficiency with presentation and virtual meeting tools (PowerPoint or Google Slides, Zoom or Teams)
* Valid driver’s license and reliable transportation for regional travel

**Preferred Qualifications**

* BPI certification (e.g., Building Analyst) or comparable field credentials
* Spanish language proficiency, including the ability to deliver training in Spanish
* Experience working with community-based organizations, nonprofits, or income-qualified programs
* Experience with Energy Trust of Oregon or other utility or public-benefit energy programs
* Background in instructional design or adult learning (e.g., train-the-trainer experience, ATD or similar certification)
* Experience creating short training videos or e-learning content
* Experience with project management software such as Asana

**Core Competencies**

* Engaging presenter and skilled facilitator
* Turns technical detail into practical, audience-appropriate guidance
* Highly organized; manages multiple priorities and meets deadlines
* Takes initiative: identifies needs and moves work forward without waiting to be asked
* Strong technical credibility and sound judgment
* Collaborative and open to feedback
* Cultural humility and community-centered values

**Success in This Role Looks Like**

* Partners and Skill Demand staff have clear, current, easy-to-use technical training and resources
* Recurring technical and documentation errors decrease in areas covered by training
* Participants rate trainings as clear and useful
* Training projects are delivered on schedule, with progress visible to the team

**Skill Demand Energy** is a culturally diverse organization focused on expanding access to energy efficiency solutions that reduce household energy burden and strengthen communities. We work at the intersection of technical expertise, public-benefit programs, and community-based delivery—supporting both individuals and organizations in navigating energy incentives, program requirements, and long-term sustainability.

Our work is grounded in partnership, accountability, and continuous improvement. We believe effective energy programs are built through clear expectations, strong relationships, and respect for the lived experiences of the communities we serve. We are a growing, collaborative team that values initiative, adaptability, and thoughtful problem-solving, and we encourage candidates who are motivated by impact and learning to apply. We invest in sharing knowledge across our teams, and this role is at the center of that work.

Skill Demand Energy is deeply committed to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion. We strive to build a workplace and programs that reflect the communities we serve, center equity in decision-making, and create inclusive systems where all people have access to opportunity, support, and success.

jobs.title: Regulatory Partnerships & Implementation Lead BoardWise | Remote
jobs.description:
BoardWise builds technology to help licensed professionals navigate regulatory matters. We’re expanding our work with licensing boards and regulatory agencies to help their teams organize, track, and manage active cases.

We’re looking for someone who understands how regulatory organizations operate—and can help us build relationships, identify practical needs, and guide successful implementations.

This role combines partnership development, consultative sales, and implementation coordination. You’ll work directly with our founding team to translate agency needs into clear proposals, focused pilots, and useful products.

**What you’ll do**

* Build relationships with licensing boards, professional regulators, and government agencies.
* Connect with executive directors, operations leaders, investigators, administrative staff, and technology and procurement teams.
* Learn how agencies currently handle complaints, investigations, documents, correspondence, deadlines, and case status.
* Identify opportunities for BoardWise to improve case organization, administrative efficiency, and visibility into pending work.
* Lead discovery conversations and coordinate product demonstrations.
* Develop proposals and pilot plans with clear scope, responsibilities, timelines, and measures of success.
* Help navigate procurement, vendor onboarding, security reviews, accessibility requirements, and other agency requirements with the appropriate specialists.
* Coordinate implementation, staff training, feedback collection, and ongoing account relationships.
* Bring agency feedback to our product team and help prioritize improvements.
* Maintain a clear pipeline of opportunities, decision-makers, next steps, and potential obstacles.

**Who you are**

You understand that deploying technology in a regulatory environment takes trust, patience, and careful follow-through. You can speak comfortably with agency leadership while also listening closely to the staff doing the daily work.

Relevant backgrounds may include:

* Licensing-board or regulatory-agency leadership, administration, investigations, or operations.
* Government technology partnerships, sales, customer success, or implementation.
* Public-sector case management or workflow software.
* Government procurement or consulting focused on agency modernization.
* Professional regulation, administrative processes, or compliance operations.

You should be comfortable writing clear proposals, managing relationships with multiple stakeholders, and working with a small team where the product and market are evolving.

Existing relationships in the regulatory community are valuable. Equally important is the ability to earn trust, understand a workflow, and move a project from an initial conversation to successful adoption.

**What success looks like**

* Qualified agency relationships with clearly understood needs.
* Pilot opportunities with an internal sponsor and a realistic approval path.
* Well-scoped deployments that staff can use effectively.
* Measurable improvements in case organization and administrative workflows.
* Strong ongoing relationships that support renewals, expansion, and referrals.

**Why BoardWise**

Regulatory processes affect professional livelihoods, public protection, and trust in institutions. The people administering those processes need practical tools that help them manage demanding work.

At BoardWise, you’ll help shape an emerging part of our business, work closely with the founders, and influence products built around real agency needs.

**To apply**

Please submit your résumé and a short note describing your experience with licensing boards, regulatory agencies, government technology, or public-sector implementations. Include an example of a partnership or project you helped move from an initial conversation to adoption, if applicable.

Please do not include confidential information from current or former employers or clients.

Pay: $150,000.00 - $300,000.00 per year

Work Location: Remote

**You Belong at Avera**

**Be part of a multidisciplinary team built with compassion and the goal of Moving Health Forward for you and our patients. Work where you matter.**

 **A Brief Overview**  
  
The EHR Application Principal Trainer - Pharmacist is an Information Technology role responsible for designing, developing, validating, maintaining, and delivering role-based application training for assigned electronic health record (EHR) and healthcare information system applications. This role partners with informatics analysts, operational leaders, subject matter experts, and the system-wide learning team as appropriate to ensure training curriculum, workflow scenarios, course assignments, and training environments accurately reflect approved system configuration, role-based access, operational workflows, and release changes for all phases of medication management and closed-loop processes. The position serves as the application training and curriculum subject matter expert, supporting safe, efficient, standardized, and optimized use of the electronic health record and related healthcare applications. This role does not own system level learning strategy, leadership development, general employee development, onboarding, compliance education, or non-EHR education programs.  
  
**What you will do**  

* Develop and maintain application curriculum: • Design, develop, maintain, and continuously improve role-based application training curriculum, lesson plans, workflow scenarios, tip sheets, job aids, exercises, eLearning content, and supporting materials for assigned EHR and healthcare information system applications, addressing all phases of medication management and closed-loop medication processes.
* Support application change control and release readiness : • Participate in application workgroups, change control discussions, upgrade planning, release reviews, testing activities, and optimization initiatives to identify training impacts and update curriculum prior to implementation.
* Analyze roles and training assignments: • Analyze end-user roles, application access, workflows, and training requirements to maintain application-specific course catalogs and support appropriate training assignments.
* Coordinate curriculum review and approval: • Facilitate curriculum review with subject matter experts, informatics application teams, and operational stakeholders to confirm workflow accuracy and obtain required approvals before implementation.
* Build, test, and maintain training environments.: • Build, validate, test, maintain, and troubleshoot training environments, training patients, exercises, and scenario data in partnership with informatics analysts and environment support teams.
* Deliver application training: • Deliver instructor-led, virtual, recorded, and targeted one-on-one application training for end users, super users, application training partners, and internal staff for assigned EHR and healthcare information systems applications.
* Evaluate training effectiveness: • Review learner feedback, assessment results, help desk trends, workflow issues, and stakeholder input to identify training gaps and implement continuous improvements to curriculum, materials, and delivery methods.

* Prepare training delivery readiness: • Prepare training materials, training records, classroom or virtual delivery tools, and required technology to support effective learning experiences. • Partner with system-wide learning resources when system-level learning platforms, templates, or reporting are required.
